title: Monotonicity of layered circuit size
statement: Let $T,T' : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings. If $L$ is recognized by a family of finite-layered circuits using only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates, with size at most $T(n)$ on inputs of length $n$, and $T(n) \le T'(n)$ for every $n$, then $L$ is recognized by such a family with size at most $T'(n)$ on inputs of length $n$.
